# Wolf trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophyWolf | Source: Wolf | Usage: Crafting, Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

The Wolf trophy is a rare drop from Wolves in the Mountains.

### Crafting

• Wolf fur cape

### Misc

• Can be displayed on an Item stand.
• Can be used to program Ballistas.
